r_code:
counts <- c(Active = 120L, Pending = 70L, Closed = 60L)
status_labels <- rep(names(counts), times = counts)
agent_labels <- rep("agent", sum(counts))
match_summary <- function(column, target) {
  printed <- summary(column)
  identical(names(printed), names(target)) && identical(as.character(printed), as.character(target))
}
status_candidates <- list(factor = factor(status_labels, levels = names(counts)), character = status_labels)
agent_candidates <- list(factor = factor(agent_labels), character = agent_labels)
agent_target <- c(Length = "250", Class = "character", Mode = "character")
status_type <- names(status_candidates)[vapply(status_candidates, match_summary, logical(1), target = counts)]
agent_type <- names(agent_candidates)[vapply(agent_candidates, match_summary, logical(1), target = agent_target)]
value <- c(status = status_type, agent_id = agent_type)
answer <- if (identical(value, c(status = "factor", agent_id = "character"))) "A" else NA_character_
note: Compare the reported summaries with R summaries for factor and character columns.
